dct_description_sm: Mozambique administrative level 0-4 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 02. This dataset is structured into 4 levels: - Admin 1: 11 província - Admin 2: 161 distrito - Admin 3: 457 posto - Admin 4: 1712 localidade Dates associated with this dataset: - 10 March 2026: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 01 January 2025: valid for use by the humanitarian community - 10 March 2026: last edit to the dataset before publishing - 01 January 2017: boundaries created by the source Contributed by [OCHA Mozambique](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-mozambique-hat). Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
